title: Full Moon
description: The Moon rises at sunset and is visible all night, fully illuminated by the Sun. The bright light washes out fainter stars and deep-sky objects, but the Moon itself is a spectacular sight — especially near the horizon due to the Moon illusion.

title: New Moon
description: The Moon is between Earth and the Sun, with its illuminated side facing away from us. The night sky is at its darkest — ideal for deep-sky observing. New moons also mark the start of each lunar cycle.
